Default Configure used /v3; earn returned granted=100, POST ping returned pong=true, analytics session join and heartbeat succeeded. Scoped native security regression, Steam sbox-dev.exe 26.10.13a build 38759734332, v2-required. All 12 assertions passed: correct signing pin; encrypted no-input POST; pin re-Configure invalidation and wrong-pin refusal after success; pin recovery; same-account sealed proxy input/response round trip; TOFU first use and persisted store; substituted signing-key/downgrade refusal; retained trusted config and a subsequent encrypted call. Proxy transport used a local delegate between the real client and host library paths, with a real HTTP backend; not a two-PC RPC test. No PostgreSQL, hosted backend, Library Manager installation or publish is asserted by this row.
